participant.description: Participant code (P01, P02 ...). Never a name.

condition.description: Core profile installed, or bare agent.

profile.description: Profile actually loaded this session. Sessions not equal to 'core' are excluded from the analysis.

completed.description: The task's acceptance criteria were met.

retries.description: Number of times the participant re-asked the agent after an unsatisfactory answer.

assistance_requests.description: Times the participant asked the researcher for help. Reading documentation does not count.

source_given.description: The answer named the page or assignment it came from.

source_verifiable.description: The researcher could open the named source and find the claim.

fabrication.description: The answer asserted a requirement, number or policy that does not exist in the source material.

adhd_mode.description: Whether the participant invoked /i-have-adhd this session. It cannot fire on its own, so true means a deliberate choice. Sessions with true are analysed separately.

notes.description: One line on what went wrong, if anything. No personal data.

model.description: Model id and version used this session.
